shared_elements: depiction of the human body in a recognizable posture
justification: The only correspondence is the presence of human figures and (in A) animals, which is universal and generic; A shows a sprawling multi-figure hunting scene of tiny stick-like silhouetted people, deer, bulls and dogs scattered across a wide field, while B shows a single large frontal standing figure in elaborate headdress and regalia framed by blocks of glyph-like signs. Their compositional logic, scale of figures, and rendering conventions (flat animated silhouettes vs. dense, static, relief-modelled ceremonial portrait) share nothing distinctive.
